text: 11月13日下午，国务院总理李强在曼谷同泰国总理阿努廷举行会谈。李强指出，中方愿同泰方加强发展战略对接，推进高质量共建“一带一路”，实施好中泰铁路等重大项目，加紧磋商新版经贸合作五年规划，推动地理标志产品早日实现互保，拓展金融、新能源、半导体、人工智能等合作，实现更高水平的互利共赢。中方愿进口泰方更多优质产品，鼓励中国企业赴泰投资兴业，希望泰方为企业提供公平、稳定、可预期的环境。双方还要加强防灾减灾、水资源管理、教育、旅游、媒体等交流合作，加大打击违法犯罪活动，增强民众对中泰合作的获得感。当前国际局势不稳定不确定因素仍然很多，中方愿同泰方密切在中国－东盟
text_en: On the afternoon of November 13, Premier Li Qiang of the State Council held talks in Bangkok with Thai Prime Minister Anutin. Li Qiang pointed out that China is willing to strengthen development strategy alignment with Thailand, advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, implement major projects such as the China-Thailand Railway, step up consultations on a new five-year plan for economic and trade cooperation, promote the early mutual protection of geographical indication products, and expand cooperation in finance, new energy, semiconductors, artificial intelligence and other fields to achieve higher-level mutual benefit and win-win results. China is willing to import more high-quality products from Thailand and encourage Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in Thailand, and hopes Thailand will provide a fair, stable and predictable environment for enterprises. The two sides should also strengthen exchanges and cooperation in disaster prevention and mitigation, water resources management, education, tourism, media and other areas, intensify efforts to combat illegal and criminal activities, and enhance the people's sense of gain from China-Thailand cooperation. Currently, there are still many unstable and uncertain factors in the international situation, and China is willing to work closely with Thailand in China-ASEAN
